question: Does independently published scholarship show 交食推步法 and 交食推步法假令 as title/usage variants, and does the Korean type-history literature narrow the plausible SNU 丙辰字 vs AKS 戊寅字 attribution tension?

source_comparison.provider: Seoul National University Kyujanggak official catalog
source_comparison.title: 交食推步法
source_comparison.metadata: 古活字本(大字는 丙辰字, 中字는 甲寅字)

source_comparison.provider: Academy of Korean Studies Encyclopedia / 戊寅字
source_comparison.scholarly_account: 1458 cast 戊寅字 for large main characters of 交食推步法假令; 甲寅字 used in medium and small annotation

source_comparison.provider: Academy of Korean Studies Encyclopedia / 丙辰字
source_comparison.scholarly_account: 1436 lead type 丙辰字 used for 資治通鑑綱目訓義 and account states that no other surviving print of this type had been observed

source_comparison.provider: Lee Ki-won, Journal of Korean Earth Science Society 29(1), 2008, pp.98-115, reviewed printed p.111 discussion and Fig.1 preface
source_comparison.relevant_statement: 交食推步假令, also called 交食推步法; preface bears 交食推步法假令; 1458 work is upper/lower eclipse-calculation examples

adjudication.new_positive: Title-only distinction between 交食推步法 and 交食推步法假令 is not a sufficient independent-work explanation for type differences: at least one scholarly publication explicitly treats names as related designations. AKS 丙辰字 limited-survival statement adds a second scoped scholarly control for checking SNU catalogue type attribution.
does_not_prove: Every copy listed as 交食推步法 and 交食推步法假令 is identical at impression/physical-copy level.
SNU first-party catalog type metadata is wrong, or AKS scholars are infallible.
1458 original formula target 盈縮加分 or typeforms are acquired or re-collated.
Exact relationship between 1436 丙辰字, 1458 戊寅字 and possible later reuse at 奎貴67.
Unverified copying or G893 original 少/微 units/quantization or six final historical numeric adjudications.
adjudication.next_gate: Obtain provider-authenticated 奎貴67 native page and item-specific colophon/typeform; distinguish type identification from original formula glyph and independent G893 printed 少/微 numerical semantics. Do not repeat generic bibliographic searches or promote modern received transcriptions to ancient original.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Title alias and historical type-family accounts are not proof of a shared physical impression, direct copying, 1458 original formula glyph or print-block lineage.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Which original typeface is actually present on the specific 奎貴67 source-original target leaves?
Is the AKS type-family observation about the same impression as SNU catalog item?
How does G893 native printed 少/微 map to unit radix, if at all?
